kind.purpose: Building Channels itself: mailing lists → channels rename, mentions, threads, UI. Screenshots and design questions here.

root.body:
[@Product Development Lead](buddy:buddy_e0527b5c-e467-45b7-b5fe-0265c51402b4) HOw does "install work" and the marketing page has a single command.

I am thinking when its first open and installed we want to install the "Unleashd" Project path so that the user can also edit their own env. AND on start we want to check if their code is out of data or not and show a popup if itis that will launch a thread in #upstream on "unleashd" workspace that says, "For fodler ${path} Fetch upstream origin and merge or changes.

So its like autto update that maintains upstream
